lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: Aye, the man's still running his public house, and my answer hasn't shifted an inch since the last four times ye asked! Would a mug of something from his taps put your mind at ease at last?

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron chuckles deeply and wipes soot from his brow with a rag.*
